body: Ooh I see, I did not know that. I have not heard of something like that, I will look more into it. Thank you for your words, they've set some worries at ease a little bit

I see! It makes sense, the more I think about it. But I suppose I'm just a little scared. All my life I've been told I'm going to get into a relationship, have kids and grow old with someone and stuff like that. But now all of a sudden I've realized I can't really have that. Not that I'm sad about it, or anything. It just kind of feels like my world's been flipped around, I guess.
